column1: # The V4 dynamic-fee (hooked zero-fee) pool census — the F2 fee-policy input.
# hook  currency0  currency1  fee  tick_spacing  pool_id
# The population: every hooked V4 pool that charges no LP fee — the 32,358
# mainnet pools with `fee_currency0 = fee_currency1 = 0` and a non-zero `hooks`
# address in ~/.local/state/degenbot/db/degenbot.db. A pool keyed at fee 0 has no
# LP fee for a hook to override, so the HOOK is the whole fee, carried as a
# `beforeSwap` swap delta (every address in this population carries the
# amount-modifying flag bits, `hooks & 0xCC != 0`). The population spans 4,478
# hooks; 24,098 of its pools (across 3,017 hooks) hold at least one recorded
# liquidity position, and the rest have nothing to price.
# Rows: the four hooks with the most pools in the population (5,833 / 5,112 /
# 2,239 / 1,289 pools), ten pools each, then one pool for each of 40 long-tail
# hooks drawn from the 3,013-hook address-ordered list of the population's
# position-holding hooks (the top four excluded). Every selection ranks a hook's
# pools by recorded position count, then by pool_hash.
#              ORDER BY (SELECT count(*) FROM managed_pool_liquidity_positions m
#       JOIN erc20_tokens t0 ON t0.id = p.currency0_id
#       JOIN erc20_tokens t1 ON t1.id = p.currency1_id
#    WHERE (rn <= 10 AND hooks IN (<the four top hooks>))
#       OR (rn <= 1 AND hooks IN (<the 40 drawn long-tail hooks>))
# with the long-tail hook indices drawn from a splitmix64 stream seeded
# 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15 over the address-ordered hook list: the stream's first 40
# Each row's pool id is re-derived from its key at parse time, so a stale or
# mistyped row fails loudly instead of quoting a different pool.
